Class LastCredentialGuard

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.core.service.LastCredentialGuard
public final class LastCredentialGuard extends Object
Keeps an identity from losing its last sign-in credential. Self-service removals run through removeIfNotLast(UUID, Supplier), which counts and removes in one transaction holding the identity's row lock, so two concurrent removals cannot both pass the check.

That transaction is READ COMMITTED whatever the database's default, because the second removal must count what the first committed once it gets the lock; under REPEATABLE READ it would count its own older snapshot, and both could pass. Called inside a transaction of the caller's, the guard joins it at that transaction's isolation, so the guarantee then holds only if that transaction is READ COMMITTED; who's own endpoints call it outside any transaction.

The credential services keep their own contract and do not apply this rule; callers that remove credentials on a person's behalf must.

      public LastCredentialGuard(IdentityRepository identityRepository, List<SignInCredentialCounter> counters, org.springframework.transaction.PlatformTransactionManager transactionManager)
      Creates the guard.
      Parameters:
      identityRepository - locks the identity's row
      counters - one counter per kind of sign-in credential
      transactionManager - runs the count and the removal in one READ COMMITTED transaction; it must manage the data source the counters and the repository use

    • removeIfNotLast

      public <T> T removeIfNotLast(UUID identityId, Supplier<T> removal)
      Runs the removal unless it would take the identity's last sign-in credential. The identity is locked, the credentials counted and the removal run in one transaction.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the result type
      Parameters:
      identityId - the identity losing a credential
      removal - removes one credential and returns a result
      Returns:
      what the removal returned
      Throws:
      LastCredentialException - if the identity holds one credential or none
